scenes.narration: At 2:17 AM, a lone trader sits in the dark. The screen flashes red.
scenes.visual_argument: A solitary trader isolated in a dark void while market monitors flash alert warnings.
scenes.visual_metaphor: A solitary human island surrounded by an ocean of nocturnal market volatility.
scenes.company_style: Locked stage archival tan and charcoal grid, B&W halftone cutout trader with rough white keyline and offset red marker shadow.
scenes.camera: Slow creeping push-in on trader's eyes reflecting red market alerts.
scenes.transition: Cut on red flash with flashing colon ':' morphing into terminal cursor.
scenes.sound: Sub-bass pulse, mechanical clock tick, deep room hum.

scenes.narration: Traders don't have an information problem. They are drowning in fourteen thousand alerts a minute.
scenes.visual_argument: Information physically overwhelms the trader, stacking endless layers of text, charts, and news clips until the screen is choked with noise.
scenes.visual_metaphor: A suffocating blizzard of financial paperwork burying the trader.
scenes.company_style: Deep diorama with aged financial newspaper columns, popping alert cards with spring overshoot, and flying red warning tags.
scenes.camera: Pulls backward fast through three layers of dense paper cutouts as they multiply.
scenes.transition: Torn newspaper edge becomes a jagged red trendline.
scenes.sound: Rapid paper rustle, accelerating ticks, data hiss.

scenes.narration: They have a signal problem. When every feed screams panic, where is the truth?
scenes.visual_argument: All conflicting arrows, charts, and headlines suddenly collapse toward one central point of focus, exposing the emptiness of the noise.
scenes.visual_metaphor: Noise collapsing into a singular gravity well.
scenes.company_style: Flat parallax on muted archival tan canvas with faded grid, bold condensed type, and hot-red marker underline.
scenes.camera: Fast lateral track then hard stop with overshoot (COUNTER_SLAM).
scenes.transition: Red marker underline pulls tight like a thread (THREAD_PULL) and snaps into a horizontal baseline coordinate.
scenes.sound: Rubber creak, counter slam thud, abrupt silence drop.

scenes.narration: CrowdWisdom doesn't guess. It indexes 1,482,930 trader inputs in real time across the globe.
scenes.visual_argument: Hundreds of individual trader cutouts light up across a tactile paper map, each feeding a red signal thread into a central convergence hub.
scenes.visual_metaphor: Thousands of human whispers aggregating into a single resounding voice.
scenes.company_style: Deep diorama with archival topographic map, B&W halftone cutouts of traders across global capitals, and giant stat numbers.
scenes.camera: Dives through the topographic map layer, orbiting a quarter turn to reveal network depth.
scenes.transition: The last digit '0' expands outward into a circular radar scope.
scenes.sound: Submerge whoosh, mechanical counter ticks (TICK_UP), paper pops.

scenes.narration: Delivering 68.4% directional accuracy—tested, verified, and proven across four hundred twenty-eight tickers.
scenes.visual_argument: A giant dual-card statistical proof stage comparing CrowdWisdom's 68.4% accuracy directly against market noise.
scenes.visual_metaphor: A precision balance scale locking into undeniable equilibrium.
scenes.company_style: Locked stage archival canvas with giant stat card stamping down (STAMP) with offset red marker keyline.
scenes.camera: Subtle slow drift lateral, maintaining locked architectural stability.
scenes.transition: The decimal point in 68.4% pulses, extruding a horizontal timeline ruler into the next scene.
scenes.sound: Heavy stamp thud, paper snap, clock tick.

scenes.narration: With a 14.6 hours early warning lead. That means seeing the institutional pivot before the candlestick breaks.
scenes.visual_argument: A clock hand sweeps across a split candlestick chart, highlighting the 14.6-hour gap between crowd sentiment shift and price collapse.
scenes.visual_metaphor: Seeing the thunderclap long before the rain falls.
scenes.company_style: Flat parallax with 24-hour timeline ruler, candlestick chart layer, and giant mustard annotation.
scenes.camera: Fast lateral track along the timeline, locking onto the divergence gap.
scenes.transition: The sentiment divergence arrow pivots 90 degrees to form the crosshair of the platform.
scenes.sound: Riser sweep, alert wash thud, track rumble.

scenes.narration: From noise, to signal, to execution. You stop trading in the dark.
scenes.visual_argument: The solitary trader from 2:17 AM reappears, but now the chaotic red screens are replaced by clean, golden CrowdWisdom intelligence vectors.
scenes.visual_metaphor: The dark room filling with morning clarity.
scenes.company_style: Deep diorama trading room illuminated by warm archival light, calm trader cutout, floating +ALPHA tags.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in past foreground floating tags directly to the calm trader.
scenes.transition: The execution button transforms into the CrowdWisdom seal lockup.
scenes.sound: Clean resonant chime, room tone settling, paper pop.
